name: text-to-speech
description: Full-stack text-to-speech app — React/Vite client, Express/Node server.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix server && npm run format --prefix client
